policies.label: Satisfy active content requirements
actions: translate active content intents into explicit output requirements
add or revise sections so the generated page visibly satisfies the requirement

policies.label: Retrieve or surface fresh context when required
actions: identify whether the active intent requires recent context
ask relevant hands/tools for fresh context or mark freshness gaps explicitly

policies.label: Respect object-scoped user behavior
actions: ground the task in the target anchor/card/object before interpreting the instruction
avoid applying local edits globally unless the user asks for global changes

policies.label: Add risk and reversal checks
actions: include counterarguments, uncertainty, downside triggers, or reversal conditions
avoid generic risks; tie each risk to the current object or decision

policies.label: Preserve user style and granularity
actions: match the user's preferred density, language, and structure
prefer reusable formatting choices that have received positive reward
